description: Action reuse assessment: reuse RunAgent -> Condition -> Concat in Batch. Condition records error presence; Concat selects populated output/error text as a cell matrix. Extend FactLookup wildcard list projection for results.*.result.matrix, reuse Concat to join matrices. W2 rejects unexpected uncaptured errors before writing. One UpdateSheetValues RAW write with actor and event config. Runtime question count, no compile-time unrolling. Verify integrated W1/W2 payload contract, agent errors in correct cells, all-error run, varying question counts, no real external calls.

comments.text: Actual W2 DAG tests exposed Runic scheduling items out of input order despite serial fork execution. Because the user explicitly keeps shared agent context, W2 needs input-order execution as well as aligned sheet cells. Add an opt-in ordered Batch chain reusing the same run_fork/StepRunner and collector, preserving existing default fan-out. Keep the strict new integration assertions; do not weaken order checks.
